description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission ref: 2019/1828 dated 17/10/2019. The variation would result in a change of material from concrete GRC to Grey creased stock brick in stretcher bond with pale colour mortar with bucket handle joints.
decision_conditions: <p>The basement and ground floor level A4 use of the development hereby permitted shall be completed and ready for occupation, including the fixtures, fittings and ancillary areas (including wcs, kitchen and internalised extract flue) before the residential part of the building is brought into use. </p><p>REASON: To ensure the public house is ready for occupation as early as possible in the development period, thereby recognising its role as an Asset of Community Value.</p>

<p>The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</p><div><br></div>

<p>At least 1 of the dwellings within the development hereby approved shall be
completed in compliance with Building Regulations Optional Requirement Part M4
(3) 'wheelchair user dwellings' (or any subsequent replacement) prior to first
occupation and shall be retained as such thereafter. All other dwellings within the
development hereby approved shall be completed in compliance with Building
Regulations Optional Requirement Part M4 (2) 'accessible and adaptable dwellings'
(or any subsequent replacement) prior to first occupation and shall be retained as
such thereafter.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development is adequately accessible for future
occupiers.</p>

<p>No soil stacks, soil vent pipes, flues, ductwork or any other pipework shall be fixed to the elevations of the building other than as shown on the drawings hereby approved, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. </p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>The use of the public house will be carried in accordance with the Operational Management Plan (Appendix One of the Planning Statement) hereby approved. </p><p>REASON: To ensure that occupiers of residential premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance or anti-social behaviour.</p>

<p>The A4 use hereby permitted may only be carried out between 1000 hours and 2300 hours Mondays to Thursdays and between 1000 hours and 0200 between Fridays and Sundays. The use may also only carried out between 1200 hours and 0000 hours on Christmas Eve and Boxing Day (if falling on a Friday or Saturday) and on New Year's Eve. </p><p>REASON: To ensure that the use operates in a satisfactory manner and does not unduly disturb adjoining occupiers or prejudice local amenity generally.</p>

<p>Soundproofing shall be provided to ensure that dwelling houses, flats and rooms
for residential purposes sharing a party element with a premises to which this
planning permission relates shall receive a minimum airborne sound insulation on
the party element which achieves DnT'w of 60 dB before the first use of the
development hereby approved. The soundproofing shall be retained thereafter in
perpetuity.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure that neighbouring occupiers do not suffer a loss of amenity by
reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise from activities within the premises</p>

<p>Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the
matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning
Authority, in writing, before the use hereby approved is commenced.
- Full details of measures to mitigate against vibration to all adjoining residential
properties.
The use shall hereby approved shall not commence until such a time as the
approved measures are implemented in full. The approved measures shall thereafter
be retained in perpetuity.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the use is operated in a satisfactory manner and does not
unduly disturb adjoining occupiers or prejudice local amenity</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a minimum of 4 Swift and/or bat nesting bricks and/or boxes shall be provided at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. The bricks/boxes shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity. </p><p>REASON: in the interests of biodiversity.</p>

<p>Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before the relevant work is commenced. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved which shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation/use of the development. </p><p>a) Windows, doors, reveals, dormer cheeks; </p><p>b) An internalised extract flue from the public house kitchen to above eaves level on the top set back element of the new five storey block; </p><p>c) Balconies, balustrades, parapets, coping;</p><p>REASON: To ensure the visual amenity of the development in context and to protect</p><p>the amenity of neighbouring residents.</p>
